name: Contact Form
summary: Responsive contact-information and native-form shell that preserves dependency-owned field and Button behavior.

anatomy.name: form
anatomy.description: Native form composition using field and Button dependencies.

states.name: default
states.description: Resting section presentation; field validation, focus, and disabled states belong to composed dependencies.

behavior.name: nativeFormSemantics
behavior.description: The target renders a native form and owns action, method, submission, pending response, success, failure, retry, and anti-abuse behavior.

behavior.name: fieldComposition
behavior.description: Composed Input and Textarea fields preserve their own label, message, native value, disabled, hover, focus-visible, and Default, Error, Success, and Warning validation contracts. If a target composes Select in this slot, Select keeps the same dependency-owned obligations; Select is not added to the current registry dependency list by this contract-only pass.

behavior.name: actionComposition
behavior.description: Submit and secondary actions compose Button and preserve Button-owned activation, disabled, busy, and focus behavior.

properties.name: details
properties.description: Target-owned repeated contact details and their native link semantics when applicable.

properties.name: form
properties.description: Native target-owned form content composed from field and Button contracts.

accessibility: Use a native form with an accessible name, associated labels and messages, and a logical source and tab order.
Input, Textarea, and any target-composed Select preserve Default, Error, Success, and Warning presentation across label, control, message, indicator, hover, and focused outer ring.
Only Error uses aria-invalid=true; all validation messages are programmatically associated and remain distinguishable without color alone.
Button-composed submission preserves visible focus, touch size, disabled and busy behavior, and target-owned response announcements.
